# JARVIS repository instructions

This is the private source-of-truth repository for Project JARVIS.

Read the complete `AGENTS.md` and complete `MASTER_TODO.md` before project work. Treat "launch/start/continue JARVIS" as resuming the JARVIS project workflow unless the user explicitly means launching the installed application.

Follow the status protocol in AGENTS.md: mark one task WORKING before implementation; use BLOCKED or PARTIAL when unfinished; only check [x] and mark VERIFIED after acceptance tests pass; update the phase/live status and dated Execution Log before ending. Keep MASTER_TODO.md as the only authoritative checklist.

Respect the $0 budget, Windows-first platform, existing OpenJarvis preservation, security/approval boundaries, and evidence-based completion rules. Never claim access to the user's PC from repository access alone.
